generation.explanation: Inverse functions swap inputs and outputs: if e^t = u, then ln(u) = t. So the point (t, u) on y = e^x corresponds to (u, t) on y = ln(x). Swapping coordinates reflects a point across y = x; move the slider to see this for different points.
